Telangana Orders Decade-Long Audit of Rice Milling System

The Telangana government has ordered a decade-long audit of its custom milling rice system. This decision aims to tighten vigilance on paddy procurement and milling processes to protect farmers. The audit will cover the period from 2014 to the present.
